name: Inngest
summary: Inngest is an event-driven durable execution platform: functions are triggered by events or schedules and broken into steps that are retried and memoized individually. The Inngest service calls your functions over HTTP (or via persistent worker connections), so it works with serverless platforms as well as long-running servers. It offers a hosted cloud and a self-hostable server.
facts: Server: SSPL with delayed Apache-2.0; SDKs: Apache-2.0
Executions (each run and each step count)
goodFor: Durable background steps on serverless hosts
Concurrency and throttling controls per key
watchOut: Server license is SSPL, not OSI open source
